source.query:
select
UUID,
Company_Cd,
Company_NmEn,
Company_NmCn,
Plant_UniId,
Factory_Cd,
Factory_NmEn,
Factory_NmCn,
Material_Status,
Material_UniId,
Material_Cd,
Material_NmCn,
Material_NmEn,
Material_Type_Cd,
Material_Type_Desc,
Procurement_Type,
Requirements,
Receipts,
Qty_Unit,
Currency,
Closing_Stock,
Closing_Stock_Amt,
Stock_Cover,
Version_Week,
Data_Year,
Data_Week,
`date`,
Etl_Tm,
Etl_Src,
Etl_Job
from dscc.Wave2_KPI_RP_OOS
WHERE `date`>=date_format(date_sub(next_day(CURRENT_DATE,'MO'),7),'yyyyMMdd')
and `date`<=date_format(date_add(date_sub(next_day(CURRENT_DATE,'MO'),7),6),'yyyyMMdd')

select * from dscc.Wave2_KPI_SO_DPA_DPB_M
where SubBU_Cd is not null
and Product_UniId is not null

with info as
(
	select trunc(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd'),'MM') as nowDate,trunc(add_months(from_unixtime(unix_timestamp(),'yyyy-MM-dd'),-1),'MM') as lastDate
)
select T1.* from dscc.Wave2_KPI_SSL_M T1
inner join info T2 
where T1.dt >= T2.lastDate and T1.dt <= T2.nowDate

with maxDtTable as (
  select max(dt) dt from dscc.Wave2_KPI_Untouched_Order_M
)
select * from dscc.Wave2_KPI_Untouched_Order_M T1 inner join maxDtTable on T1.dt = maxDtTable.dt
